And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Jagdeep Singh Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I,J.
Heard Sri Jagdeep Singh Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Veer Raghav Chaubey,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant for quashing the impugned charge sheet No.01 dated 16.03.2022 submitted by the investigating officer before the court of learned Special Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lucknow as well as cognizance/ summoning order dated 26.04.2022 passed by the learned Special Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lucknow in Case No.46272 of 2022 (State vs. Sunil Kumar) arising out of F.I.R./ Case Crime No.51 of 2022, under Sections 406, 420 I.P.C., Police Station Malihabad, District Lucknow and the entire proceedings of aforesaid Criminal Case No.46272 of 2022 (State vs. Sunil Kumar), pending in the court of learned Special Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lucknow.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that though no one has appeared on behalf of learned counsel for opposite party No.2 today, however, he has drawn attention of this Court to compromise dated 15.03.2023 annexed as annexure No.9 to the instant application, which has been signed by the accused/ applicant as well as the opposite party No.2 also.

1 dispute amicably out of the Court and have decided not to contest the case against each other.

sentences.text: Whether the parties have, in fact, compromised the matter or not, can best be ascertained by the court below, as such, compromise has to be duly verified in presence of the concerned parties before the court below.

Accordingly, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court concerned that if any such compromise is filed before it, notices be issued to all the concerned parties including the injured or victim, if any, requiring their personal presence and, thereafter, proceed to verify the compromise.
If the aforesaid compromise is verified, a report to that effect shall be prepared by the court concerned and the compromise will be made part of the record.

The court concerned in that scenario will allow the parties to obtain certified copy of the report as well as compromise and it will be open to the applicant to approach this Court again for quashing of the proceedings.

The Registry of the Court is directed to return the original compromise deed, if any, annexed with the instant application to the learned counsel for the applicant after retaining a photocopy of the same on record.

During the process of verification, the impugned cognizance/ summoning order dated 26.04.2022 passed by the learned Special Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lucknow or any process issued pursuant thereto, shall not be given effect to qua the present applicant, Sunil Kumar.

(Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I, J.) Order Date :- 22.3.2023 cks/-
